parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description: The ID of the check item.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description: The name of the field that is used to query containers.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the field that is used to query containers.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asset group.

> You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~130972~~) operation to query the ID of the asset group.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

> We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The keyword that is used to query servers in fuzzy match mode.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs.

parameters.name: RiskType
parameters.description: The type of the check item.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. Default value: default. Valid values:

*   **default**: The check items of baselines for hosts.
*   **agentless**: The check items of baselines for agentless detection.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the check item. Valid values:

*   **1**: failed
*   **2**: verifying
*   **3**: passed
*   **6**: ignored
*   **7**: fixing
*   **8**: fixed

parameters.name: UuidList
parameters.description: The UUID array of the servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-check-item-warning-machine --check-id 8 --risk-type cis --status 3 --remark 225 --container-field-name clusterId --container-field-value ce89cdd0ea732472a8703821b19e0000 --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --group-id 11610000 --source agentless --uuid-list 4fe8e1cd-3c37-4851-b9de-124da32c0000 --resource-directory-account-id 1082098404740323 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
